entities.name: Voyager 1
entities.look: Boxy body with a large high-gain dish antenna, multiple booms, and a golden record attached.

entities.name: Titan rocket
entities.look: Tall multi-stage white rocket with strap-on boosters, 1970s era.

places.name: Cape Canaveral
places.look: Coastal launch pad with gantry structures, blue sky, 1970s era, no people.

places.name: Deep Space
places.look: Black void of space with distant stars, nebulae, no people or planets close by.

moments.action: lifted off from Cape Canaveral on a Titan rocket
moments.cue: Voyager 1 lifted off from Cape Canaveral on a Titan rocket.

moments.cue: Voyager 1 swung past its rings and its giant moon, Titan.

moments.action: swapped in backups and entered a safe state

moments.action: keep falling outward with its golden record
